title: Sharpen and upscale
description: Upscale a clip 2x or 4x with NVIDIA RTX super resolution, or clean noise and sharpen soft footage at its original size. Sound and frame rate stay the same. Needs an NVIDIA RTX GPU.

requirements.name: LoadVideo
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version providing LoadVideo.

requirements.name: GetVideoComponents
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version providing GetVideoComponents.

requirements.name: RTXVideoSuperResolution
requirements.instructions: Install ComfyUI Nvidia VFX Nodes v0.2.1 and the nvidia-vfx runtime into ComfyUI's own Python, then restart ComfyUI. See docs/NVIDIA-VFX.md.

requirements.name: CreateVideo
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version providing CreateVideo.

requirements.name: SaveVideo
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version providing SaveVideo.

evidence: 2026-10-25: installed ComfyUI Nvidia VFX Nodes at commit 38d790d (pyproject version 0.2.1) and nvidia-vfx 0.2.0.0 into ComfyUI 0.37.0's Python. The node module exposed RTXVideoSuperResolution, RTXTrueHDR and RTXVideoFrameGeneration. This template has not had a GPU run; execution, output quality and the local allowlist review are still open.
